# hygiene/elided-code

Placeholder comment where code was dropped.

A comment such as `// ... existing code ...`, `// rest of the implementation`, or `/* ... */` as the only content of a body, added in the change.

- Default level: `block`.
- Looks at: what the change did, comparing each file before and after.
- References: [CWE-1164](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1164.html).

## Why it matters

Models that rewrite a whole file sometimes write a placeholder comment instead of repeating code they did not change, and the code behind it is deleted. The file may still compile while a function body, a list of routes, or a component is gone.

## Flagged

`README.md` (block):

```md
<!-- ... rest of the file unchanged ... -->
```

`src/components/Profile.tsx` (block):

```tsx
{/* ... */}
```

`src/routes.ts` (block):

```ts
// ... existing routes ...
```

`src/routes.ts` (block):

```ts
// rest of the implementation
```

`app/worker.py` (block):

```python
# ... rest of the implementation
```

## Not flagged

- `ok: comments in fenced code blocks are documentation, not elision.` in `README.md`: comments in fenced code blocks are documentation, not elision.
- `export const routes = [` in `docs/snippets/router.ts`: code under docs/ is documentation, where placeholder comments are deliberate
- `return fn().catch((error) => {` in `src/routes.ts`: prose that starts with an ellipsis is not elision
- `export function sample() {` in `test/fixtures/rewritten.ts`: fixture files hold example input for tests
- src/cart.ts: `/* ... */` next to other code in the same body is not the only content

## How to fix

Restore the code the comment replaced from the previous version of the file, and remove the comment.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore hygiene/elided-code: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "hygiene/elided-code": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
